Package index

Working with results

Every selection function except fs_pca() and fs_svd() returns an fs_result. These functions print it, summarize it, and extract the selected names.

selected()
Extract the selected features from a featR result
print(<fs_result>)
Print a featR result
summary(<fs_result>)
Summarize a featR result

Filters

Score each feature without fitting a predictive model. They are fast and work on wide data, but they judge one feature at a time, so they miss features that only help in combination.

fs_supervised()
Supervised filter that scores each feature against a target
fs_unsupervised()
Unsupervised filter that scores each feature without a target
fs_chi()
Chi-squared tests for categorical features
fs_infogain()
Rank features by information gain
fs_correlation()
Find and prune highly correlated variables

Regularization and embedded importance

Fit one model and keep the features it uses: nonzero coefficients for the lasso and elastic net, variable importance for random forests, and the terms of the final MARS model.

fs_lasso()
Lasso feature selection with cross-validation
fs_elastic()
Elastic-net feature selection with tuned alpha and lambda
fs_randomforest()
Random forest importance with a held-out evaluation
fs_mars()
MARS (earth) feature selection

Wrappers

Refit a model on many candidate subsets and keep the best one. They are the slowest family, and their choice is tied to the model they refit.

fs_recursivefeature()
Recursive feature elimination with held-out evaluation
fs_svm()
Train and evaluate an SVM, with optional SVM-RFE feature selection
fs_boruta()
All-relevant feature selection with Boruta
fs_stepwise()
Stepwise linear-regression feature selection by AIC
fs_bayes()
Bayesian predictor-subset selection with brms and LOO

Dimensionality reduction

Replace the original columns with new components instead of keeping a subset. These return a list of their own rather than an fs_result.

fs_pca()
Principal component analysis with tidy results and optional plotting
fs_svd()
Singular value decomposition with optional scaling and truncation

Package

featR featR-package
featR: A Unified Toolkit for Feature Selection
